mcqs.question: What was the mascot of the inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games 2026 held in Chhattisgarh?
mcqs.explanation: Morveer was the mascot of the inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games 2026. Karnataka, Odisha and Jharkhand were participating States associated with the medal standings, not the mascot.

mcqs.question: Which State topped the inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games 2026 on the basis of gold medals?
mcqs.explanation: Karnataka ranked first with 23 gold medals and topped the Games on golds. Odisha won more total medals, 57, but had 21 golds; Jharkhand had 16 golds and Andhra Pradesh ranked 16th.

mcqs.question: Whom will R Vaishali challenge after winning the FIDE Women's Candidates 2026?
mcqs.explanation: R Vaishali won the FIDE Women's Candidates 2026 and became the challenger to Ju Wenjun. Kateryna Lagno was her final-round opponent, while Aronyak Ghosh became India's 95th Grandmaster.

mcqs.question: Who won the men's singles silver medal at the Badminton Asia Championships 2026 and became the first Indian finalist in 61 years?
mcqs.explanation: Ayush Shetty won the men's singles silver medal and became the first Indian finalist in 61 years. Dinesh Khanna was the earlier Indian champion referred to in this milestone, not the 2026 finalist.

mcqs.question: What time did Sebastian Sawe record in the London Marathon 2026 to become the first athlete with an official sub-two-hour marathon?
mcqs.explanation: Sebastian Sawe of Kenya finished in 1:59:30, becoming the first athlete to record an official sub-two-hour marathon. Yomif Kejelcha ran 2:00:28, while 2:00:35 was the previous world record.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Abhishek Sharma was named T20 Cricketer of the Year in the Wisden Awards.
Statement B: Deepti Sharma was named Women's Cricketer of the Year in the Wisden Awards.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Abhishek Sharma received the T20 Cricketer of the Year award, while Deepti Sharma received the Women's Cricketer of the Year award.

mcqs.question: Where was the inaugural ICC Women's T20I Challenge Trophy 2026 held?
mcqs.explanation: The inaugural ICC Women's T20I Challenge Trophy 2026 was held in Kigali at Gahanga Stadium. Ningbo hosted the Badminton Asia Championships, Bishkek hosted the wrestling championships and Cairo hosted the ISSF Junior World Cup.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the Asian Wrestling and Boxing Championships 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India finished fifth in wrestling with 17 medals.
2. Iran topped wrestling with 5 gold medals.
3. India finished third in boxing with 16 medals.
Which of the statements given above is correct?
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: India finished fifth in wrestling with 17 medals. Iran topped wrestling with 6 gold medals, and India finished second in boxing with 16 medals, making statements 2 and 3 incorrect.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the shooting and para-archery highlights of April 2026:
Statement A: Payal Nagh became the world's first quadruple amputee to win international archery gold.
Statement B: Palak and Mukesh Nelavalli won gold in the 10m air pistol mixed team event with a score of 487.7, a world and junior world record.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Payal Nagh achieved the first international archery gold by a quadruple amputee, while Palak and Mukesh Nelavalli set the world and junior world record with 487.7 in the 10m air pistol mixed team event.

mcqs.question: Who won the SAFF U-20 title in Male on April 3 after the final against India ended 0–0 and was decided on penalties?
mcqs.explanation: Bangladesh won the SAFF U-20 title by defeating India 4–3 on penalties after a 0–0 draw. This was Bangladesh’s second title. India was the defeated finalist, while FIFA and OCA were not the winners of this tournament.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the 2027 World Para Athletics Championships is incorrect?
options: The championships will be held in Tashkent.
The event will be the first World Para Athletics Championships in Central Asia.
The championships will be held in June 2028.
The 2027 championships will be the 13th edition.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the championships will be held in June 2028; they are scheduled for June 2027. Tashkent will host the 13th edition, which will be the first World Para Athletics Championships in Central Asia.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh and Telangana at the Khelo India Tribal Games 2026:
1. Andhra Pradesh ranked 16th with 5 medals.
2. Telangana ranked 17th with 5 medals.
3. Andhra Pradesh ranked 17th with 5 medals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Andhra Pradesh ranked 16th with 5 medals, while Telangana ranked 17th with 5 medals. Statement 3 is incorrect because Andhra Pradesh ranked 16th, not 17th.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II in the context of Indian sports institutions and organisations:

List-I
 a. Khelo India
 b. Sports Authority of India
 c. Indian Olympic Association
 d. President of the Indian Olympic Association

List-II
 i. P.T. Usha
 ii. 2018
 iii. 1984
 iv. 1927

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Khelo India—2018, Sports Authority of India—1984, Indian Olympic Association—1927, and P.T. Usha—President of the Indian Olympic Association. Therefore, code a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i is correct.

mcqs.question: Which country topped the medal tally at the 43rd Badminton Asia Championships 2026 held in Ningbo, China?
mcqs.explanation: South Korea topped the Badminton Asia Championships 2026 medal tally with 3 gold, 1 silver and 1 bronze medal. China finished second and India fourth, so neither is the correct answer.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Wisden Awards:
1. The Wisden Five comprised Shubman Gill, Mohammed Siraj, Rishabh Pant, Ravindra Jadeja and Haseeb Hameed.
2. Mitchell Starc was named Men's Cricketer in the World.
3. Mitchell Starc was included in the Wisden Five.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the Wisden Five included the five named players, while Mitchell Starc was Men's Cricketer in the World. Statement 3 is incorrect because Starc received the latter honour and was not listed among the Wisden Five.

mcqs.question: Which combination is correct regarding the Wisden Almanack and the International Cricket Council?
options: Wisden Almanack first published in 1909; ICC headquarters in the UK
Wisden Almanack first published in 1909; ICC headquarters in Dubai
Wisden Almanack first published in 1864; ICC headquarters in Kuala Lumpur
Wisden Almanack first published in 1864; ICC headquarters in Dubai
mcqs.explanation: The Wisden Almanack was first published in 1864 and is known as the ‘Bible of Cricket’; the ICC has its headquarters in Dubai. The other options incorrectly change either the publication year or the ICC headquarters.

mcqs.question: Who was the Chairman of the International Cricket Council during the inaugural ICC Women's T20I Challenge Trophy 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Jay Shah was the Chairman of the International Cricket Council during the inaugural ICC Women's T20I Challenge Trophy 2026. Luciano Rossi, Arkady Dvorkovich and P.T. Usha are associated with other sporting organisations or offices.

mcqs.question:
Match the athletes or organisation in List-I with the corresponding detail in List-II:

List-I
 a. Sujeet Kalkal
 b. Abhimanyu Mandwal
 c. Vishwanath Suresh
 d. Asian Boxing Confederation

List-II
 i. 50 kg boxing category
 ii. 65 kg freestyle wrestling category
 iii. 70 kg freestyle wrestling category
 iv. Headquarters in Dubai

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: Sujeet Kalkal won gold in the 65 kg freestyle category, Abhimanyu Mandwal in the 70 kg freestyle category, and Vishwanath Suresh competed in the 50 kg boxing category. The Asian Boxing Confederation has its headquarters in Dubai, making a-ii, b-iii, c-i, d-iv correct.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements regarding the shooting, squash and archery highlights of April 2026 are correct?
1. India topped the ISSF Junior World Cup in Cairo with 16 medals, including 5 gold, 6 silver and 5 bronze.
2. At the Asia Squash Federation Awards, Abhay Singh was named Asia's Best Male Player 2025, Anahat Singh was Best Female (Junior), and India's boys' team was Best Team.
3. The ISSF was established in 1975 and has its headquarters in Hong Kong.
4. The World Squash Federation was established in 1977.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct, so exactly two statements are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the ISSF dates to 1907 and is headquartered in Munich; statement 4 is incorrect because the World Squash Federation dates to 1967.

mcqs.question: Where is the headquarters of the Badminton Asia organisation?
mcqs.explanation: Badminton Asia, established in 1959, has its headquarters in Kuala Lumpur. Lausanne, Dubai and Munich are incorrect locations for its headquarters.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the Volleyball Federation of India:
1. FIVB revoked its recognition.
2. The steering committee was formed by FIVB and OCA.
3. FIVB retained recognition of the Volleyball Federation of India.

Which of the statements given above is correct?
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: FIVB revoked recognition of the Volleyball Federation of India. The steering committee was an FIVB–IOA committee, and recognition was revoked rather than retained.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the proposed 2038 Asian Games.

List-I
 a. India’s proposal for the 2038 Asian Games
 b. OCA decision on the 2038 Asian Games
 c. 2030 Asian Games
 d. 2034 Asian Games

List-II
 i. Expression of Interest submitted by India
 ii. Decision in 2028
 iii. Doha
 iv. Riyadh

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv: India submitted an Expression of Interest, the OCA decision is due in 2028, Doha is scheduled for 2030 and Riyadh for 2034. The other codes interchange these dates, places and proposal details.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about recently deceased sports personalities:
1. C.D. Gopinath was the last surviving member of India’s first Test win.
2. Gurbux Singh Grewal won a hockey silver medal at the 1968 Mexico Olympics.
3. Oscar Schmidt was an India basketball legend and was inducted into the Hall of Fame in 2013.

Which of the statements given above is correct?
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: C.D. Gopinath was the last surviving member of India’s first Test win. Gurbux Singh Grewal won a hockey bronze at the 1968 Mexico Olympics, while Oscar Schmidt was a Brazil basketball legend inducted into the Hall of Fame in 2013.

mcqs.question:
With reference to recent international sports developments, consider the following statements:
1. India was among the 12 countries selected under FIFA Women's Football Development.
2. Mithun Manhas is the President of the BCCI.
3. The OCA is associated with 1982 and Kuwait City, while the IPC is associated with 1989 and Bonn; Andrew Parsons is the IPC President and Gianni Infantino is the FIFA President.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. India was among the 12 selected countries, Mithun Manhas is the BCCI President, and the stated organisational details and presidencies are associated with the OCA, IPC and FIFA. The tempting option “1 and 3 only” is incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.

mcqs.question:
The Mumbai Cricket Association introduced its first annual contracts for domestic players. Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
 a. Category A
 b. Category B
 c. Category C

List-II
 i. ₹12–20 lakh
 ii. ₹8–12 lakh
 iii. ₹8 lakh
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii and c-iii: Category A received ₹12–20 lakh, Category B ₹8–12 lakh and Category C ₹8 lakh. The tempting second code wrongly exchanges the remuneration ranges for Categories A and B.
